window: Written from about a year of each account's public posts, read on 2026-09-30.

entries.note: Talks to the timeline like it's her kitchen and you're already sitting in it. One minute it's the guy in her DMs working up from inspirational reels to the flirty one, the next it's feminising band names into The Vulva Underground. Ran away with first place. Nobody's shocked.
entries.line: if you kiss at Olive Garden is that incest?

entries.note: Invented the word wristlace and then simply would not let it go until the rest of us started saying it. It worked. Second place for a man whose entire operation is turning up under your post to say something deeply stupid.
entries.line: unlike you guys, i only suffer from posters gladness

entries.note: Will heckle you from the next stall over and then tell you he loves you. Has a fifteen-year crush on Michelle Obama and would like Barack not to find out.
entries.line: The only word I’ve said aloud today is fuck. But in 3 different octaves!

entries.note: Six feet of radioactive decay and candy, and the self-appointed mother of this website. Short jokes, dropped from height. Has told her dad Lindsey Graham died three separate times in one day and will do it again.
entries.line: i saved thousands on my car insurance by returning to the sea

entries.note: Files dispatches from a Bluesky that doesn't exist. Leaked scoops, recovered patents, a late-night radio show where you're caller twelve, and the occasional announcement that he's retired and you should follow JerryVEVO. People keep replying seriously. He keeps going.
entries.line: caller 12 you’re on bluesky at night what’s on your mind

entries.note: Works at Bluesky. Posts like she's trying to get fired. Deletes the evidence afterwards, so the feed is basically a crime scene somebody keeps tidying.
entries.line: the boys are never coming back to town. the boys have been dead for 10 years.

entries.note: A pun factory running three shifts and no safety inspections. How I Met Your Mordor. The meow in homeowner. Getting roasted by your kids is getting youthanized. He cannot stop and, frankly, should not.
entries.line: what if cats sense you’re dying a little inside and biscuits is just kitty cpr

entries.note: Gets annoyed at exactly the right things. Overnight oats are now a haunted house prop labelled “iced brains” and there's nothing anyone can do about it. Also wants the baking potatoes to explode and take the neighbourhood with them.
entries.line: God, grant me the courage to change the things I can and incredible new powers to change the things I can’t.

entries.note: Convinced Tolkien ran out of dwarf names around clorgen and bloin. Will defend the low-effort post as an art form and then immediately post something excellent, which rather undermines the argument.
entries.line: “wow what a low effort post.” yes. exactly. it’s a post

entries.note: Bio says “just here to have fun online.” Sir, you are extremely angry about four competing fascist movements. Also you invented the Slow Toads-Infused Shrimped Kraut Crumb Lump, so it checks out.
entries.line: I climbed up on my shed roof last week and installed a panel to charge my yard tools and now I’m mowing my lawn with power I stole from a fucking star

entries.note: Hockey, Netflix, and a perfect little run of ghost jokes where the haunting is just a crush. Will mute an all-time banger over missing alt text. Correct behaviour.
entries.line: ghosts only haunt you if you’re their crush

entries.note: A pizza account that spent this entire contest loudly campaigning for Greg to beat her. Made the list anyway. Possibly the happiest person on the internet.
entries.line: Dear Bluesky Elders, Tell us stories of the days when Bluesky was fun.

entries.note: Already reviewed himself: used to be funny, now just gets mad about trade policy. He's being modest. Recently ranked his mutuals by mouthfeel, which is not a thing a normal person does.
entries.line: i’ve been going to a weekly support group called Hope but every once in a while they skip a week

entries.note: Will explain, with genuine scholarship, why your brown tweed is not actually brown, and then tell you he dresses exclusively for dogs because they can't see the other colours. Six hundred thousand people turned up for menswear advice. They stayed for this.
entries.line: heartbroken to learn the pope sympathizes with the poor. how can i continue to believe in god

entries.note: Middling jokes and existential dread, sold together, no refunds. Every post is a small diagnosis you didn't ask for from a man who has been awake since 2am reading about uncontacted tribes.
entries.line: A group of people who refuse to get help is called a family

entries.note: A black cat who loves horror, definitely not a witch, lifts heavy things. The Home Depot skeletons have unionised and are fighting for bonefits. There is a cat checkpoint and the toll is one pspsps.
entries.line: Pour one out for all the guys who can’t talk to their girlfriends because ChatGPT is down

entries.note: Describes himself as a flaming dumpster and then works very hard to earn it. Eight straight days in bed, rebranded as beast mode. Currently dating a glazed ham. Genuinely thrilled that nobody cares what he says.
entries.line: The enemy of my enemy is probably still my enemy, a lot of people don’t like me.

entries.note: Turns up in your replies at 3am in lowercase with a pun you'll be annoyed about for the rest of the week. The first rule of spite club is we cut our noses.
entries.line: people should post less whiny and more whimsy

entries.note: Writes jokes the way other people build IKEA furniture, except his don't wobble. The serenity prayer, but he wants a horse that solves crimes. The Onion pays him and he is still underpriced.
entries.line: God, grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, courage to change the things I can, and a horse that solves crimes

entries.note: Does two-handers like it's sketch homework he actually finished. Peter Parker, Mary Jane, a dead uncle named Ben, and then she's singing Barenaked Ladies. You saw it coming. It got you anyway.
entries.line: ME: pack a bag, we’re flying to kansas MY WAYWARD SON: what kind of bag

entries.note: Hockey, filth, and a goaltender called Bussi whose every conceded goal she treats as a personal gift. Knows exactly what this site is doing to her. Logging on regardless.
entries.line: therapist: and what should we do when we’re feeling this way? me: keep posting 🙂‍↕️

entries.note: Mostly turns up in your replies to be nice to you. Then, with no warning whatsoever, says something that guts you. Rude, honestly.
entries.line: I should learn how to heal without scabbing over.

entries.note: Named himself Better Things Are Possible and now spends every day explaining why they currently aren't. Bleak! Very funny though. Reports that Socrates looked like a beluga whale and still had game.
entries.line: Going to work now feels like doing homework after the teacher quit and told the class that education is fake.

entries.note: Spokesperson for beavers. Insists you take every word seriously. HR has asked him to stop calling his coworkers mortals, which he considers discrimination against high deities. Campaigned shamelessly for this list, which honestly is the correct attitude.
entries.line: Heartburn is your body quietly preparing you for your final form as a fire-breathing dragon with terrible gastrointestinal health.

entries.note: HORRORS AND HOT DOGS, USUALLY IN CAPITALS, LIKE A HAUNTED SUPERMARKET TANNOY. God has turned up to ask Margaret what in the holy fuck is going on down there, and nobody has an answer.
entries.line: Not a manic pixie dream girl, but a lethargic troll nightmare woman.

entries.note: All lowercase, “tbh” used as punctuation, watching the same news as you but saying it four seconds sooner. Then he'll stop everything to ask what single item a junk drawer legally requires to qualify as a junk drawer.
entries.line: in your next zoom interview have not only a cup of ice coffee but seven or eight different cups of various beverages just off camera and casually drink from each

entries.note: Her mom fucked a bat. Everything after that follows logically. Slips into something more comfortable by walking into the ocean, bursts into bats while denying being a witch, and is cheerful throughout.
entries.line: “All those moments will be lost in time, like cum in the rain…”

entries.note: Has one format and has driven it into places it had no business surviving — is it cum, is it a toilet, is it be dead, is it waking up. Delivers everything in the voice of a nan telling a story she's told before, complete with 😬.
entries.line: just like you guys, i put my pants on one leg at a time, leaning against a wall, losing my balance, falling to my knees, yelling “FUCK”

entries.note: Empty inside, full-figured outside, warmest person here by a mile. Rewrote Dylan Thomas in eleven words. Turned her own divorce anniversary into a thread where everyone else got to feel good.
entries.line: Do not go willy into that good nilly

entries.note: Keeps getting tasered by a zookeeper for shouting puns too loudly, which is the recurring bit and also, one suspects, a documentary. Eagles are talonted. Pythons are wraptiles. There is a Superman prequel called Jurassic Clark.
entries.line: If a baby hands you a toy telephone to answer, that’s a sign of great respect in their culture.

entries.note: Feral, foul-mouthed, lifts weights, does hair, and is genuinely losing it over a bird in her bird bath. Delighted when rich men's rockets explode. Says good morning with a pink heart twenty minutes later.
entries.line: It’s a motherfucking bird in my motherfucking bird bath! These are the things you find exciting when you’re 45.

entries.note: A raccoon with a personal vendetta against Ed Sheeran. Will sell out instantly and tell you the going rate. Points out the engagement bait while being the engagement bait, so there is genuinely no way to get him.
entries.line: hating on me is just a weak attempt at engagement bait

entries.note: “she/her • i hat typos” and she has not fixed it. Every post is a bad idea presented as practical advice. The dik-dik is perfect. Everything else is not.
entries.line: Live every day like it’s your last. Key a cop car. Eat five hot dogs. Call your boss a taint. Who cares anymore?

entries.note: Co-owned by two cats. Furious at anti-vaxxers one minute, posting an upside-down floof as a timeline cleanse the next. Has explained the whole thing better than anyone else could.
entries.line: We have two settings: 1) Silly 2) Crushed under the weight of crippling depression

entries.note: Czar for life, master strategist, window installer, wanted in 123 countries. Still reporting live from day 1,391 of his three-day war. The bio says “parody, apparently” and you can hear the sigh.
entries.line: Do not believe anything until the Kremlin denies it™️

entries.note: Would help lift your spirits but she's got a bad back. Specialises in threats delivered very pleasantly, and in being sincerely unhinged about how much she loves dogs.
entries.line: “Measure twice, cut once,” I grunt, as I realise your legs won’t fit in the freezer.

entries.note: Posts like a voicemail from someone not entirely sure they've got the right number. The moon told him to stop crying and start metal detecting. He once carried a barstool into the woods to gesture at the road less travelled. Twenty-two people knew what they were doing.
entries.line: Don’t ever let anyone tell you where your wires go. You’ve got the perfect maze of loops and decoys already

entries.note: Runs a gentle little universe where the killbot politely offers to murder you or make a smoothie, and you should throw a bit of cheese on the oven floor for the oven, as a treat. Has not been mean once.
entries.line: hey, remember: don’t eat anything and don’t breathe
